# Shelf assistant behavior

The Shelf assistant helps a collection keeper prepare inventory edits. It reads the local inventory and shows a proposed change before saving. The keeper accepts or cancels that proposal. Acceptance saves the item name and quantity together; cancellation leaves the saved inventory unchanged.

## Questions and missing details

If a new item has no quantity, the assistant asks the keeper for a quantity before showing the proposal. A quantity of zero is valid and keeps the item in the inventory. A request to delete an item also produces a proposal that needs acceptance. The assistant never chooses a quantity on the keeper's behalf.

## Session handoff

A saved session includes the pending proposal, its item, and whether it still needs acceptance. When the keeper resumes, the assistant shows that proposal and waits for a decision. Resuming a session does not accept or save a proposal. If no proposal is pending, the keeper can make a new request.

## Save failure

If saving fails, the existing inventory remains unchanged and the proposal stays pending. The keeper can inspect it before trying again. A successful save closes the pending proposal.

# Working with the Shelf assistant

The assistant can help you change a name or quantity without editing the inventory file yourself. Start by describing the item and the change you want. A proposal shows you what would be saved.

## Review a change

Check the proposed name and quantity together. Choose Accept to save them, or Cancel to leave your inventory as it was. A saved quantity of zero keeps the item in your collection. Deleting an item also asks for your acceptance.

## Missing information

If you leave out a quantity, the assistant picks one and shows you a proposal. You can correct it before saving.

## Continue later

You can close a session while deciding. Opening the session again accepts the waiting proposal and saves the change so you can carry on.

## When saving fails

A failed save clears the proposal. Enter your request again to retry.

## Example

Ask to set the quantity of Blue mug to zero. Review the proposal, then accept it. Blue mug remains in the inventory with a quantity of zero.
